Ajin Varghese Chandy is a software developer and indie builder from Kerala, India, focused on building web applications, Chrome extensions, AI-powered tools, and internet products.

About

Ajin builds practical digital products that solve real problems. His work spans full-stack web development, AI integrations, browser extensions, automation, and experimental internet businesses.

His interests include shipping independent products, exploring new technologies, and turning software projects into useful tools for real users.

Projects

Real-Time Internet Speed Monitor

A Chrome extension that monitors internet connection speed in real time.

Repository: https://github.com/ajin-varghese-chandy/real-time-internet-speed

AI Clips Your Video

An AI-powered video clipping tool that uses transcription and video processing to help extract useful clips from longer recordings.

Repository: https://github.com/ajin-varghese-chandy/aiclipsyour.video

Leaf Disease Detection

A web application for identifying plant diseases, built with a FastAPI backend and integrated AI capabilities.

Repository: https://github.com/ajin-varghese-chandy/leaf-diseases-detect

Technical Interests

Frontend development: React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS

Backend development: Node.js, Express, Python, FastAPI

Databases: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL

AI integrations: Large language models, AI APIs, speech transcription, and AI-powered automation

Browser extensions: Chrome Extension APIs and real-time monitoring tools

Media processing: FFmpeg, audio transcription, and automated video clipping

Payments: Razorpay integration

Deployment: Vercel and cloud application hosting

Professional Focus

Ajin is interested in full-stack engineering, AI-enabled applications, independent software products, developer tools, and sustainable internet businesses.
